doc: T-10 proposal (#4114): staged ledger rows for KEEP lifecycle modules that cite an issue. Not applied; awaiting steward approval. summary is a draft from the triage note.

new_bugs.summary: Traps user-authored same-name rules, hooks and MCP configs being overwritten or deleted (#1662); needs many targets, global scope and JSONC.
Registered marketplace refs and branch-selected artifacts are explicitly excluded.
Asserts manifest comments and authoring bytes, beyond replay-row assertions.
Traps Kiro agent frontmatter filtering, nested paths and fail-closed tools; needs kiro target and deployed byte content.
Traps older CLI refusing newer-generator lockfiles before writes; needs apm_version lockfile edits, bundles and user scope.
Broad MCP/LSP configuration contract across targets and scopes (#2345); needs MCP registry, LSP plugins, user scope and native config bytes.
Cursor user-scope behavior is outside the project-Copilot replay cell.
Traps pack certifying degraded marketplace metadata during outages (#2524); needs network marketplace and pack --check-clean.
Traps TLS failure hints naming the wrong trust mode and non-atomic failed installs (#2602); needs HTTPS proxy and CA trust configuration.
Traps per-dependency MCP targets scoping and per-target pruning; needs several targets, user scope, MCP config contents.
Traps marketplace package --category round-trip into pack outputs; marketplace and pack are outside replay vocabulary.
Traps GitLab namespace-ancestry policy composition and fail-closed partial chains; needs HTTPS policy proxy and policy cache.
Tests target identity for Grok, not the replay model's Copilot target.
User-scope hook home reference is outside project-only Copilot replay rows.
Traps prune of manifestless skills and released roots hosting nested dependencies (#2926, #3699); needs prune, aliases and git subdirectory packages.
Traps user-scope hook $HOME path migration keeping user hooks; needs user scope, claude settings bytes, baseline binary.
Dry-run and transitive preview assertions are outside supported replay steps.
Native Claude hook behavior uses a non-Copilot target.
Traps unsatisfied persisted skill selection refusing without losing skills; needs skill subsets, claude target, ownership snapshots.
Native Copilot Agent Plugin declarations and drift assertions exceed supported package shapes.
Asserts exact cross-platform deployed bytes under Git EOL settings.
Traps --refresh and update trusting stale TTL marketplace caches (#3279, #3961); needs HTTPS catalogs, cache state and codex target.
Traps retirement of obsolete absent dependency claims within preservation boundaries; needs legacy lock fields, user scope, multiple targets.
Public GitHub request budgeting and marker validation are excluded network behaviors.
Tests independently owned assets within a shared skill directory.
Traps per-audience marketplace catalogs via add --path; marketplace is outside replay vocabulary.
Traps semver-range replay of monorepo subdirectory tags with origin removed; needs git semver tags and provenance lock fields.
Traps staged activation failures losing prior packages, including Windows handle denials (#3386); needs fault injection and native Windows.
Traps fresh-clone restore deleting committed claude_skill/skill_bundle output (#3391, #3372); needs git clones, receipts and edited-file bytes.
Traps packed plugin.json carrying stale versions and non-deterministic bundles (#3408, #3604); needs pack and bundle bytes.
Named Claude profiles and Codex user scope are outside the project-Copilot row cell.
Traps cross-profile deletion or resurrection across Claude profiles; needs user scope, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR profiles, git tags, cache clean.
Resolved-tag pin stability is explicitly excluded ref behavior.
Traps behavior of a pre-existing empty skill directory, a specific filesystem edge case.
Traps apm install DIR classifying source packages versus pack bundles; needs pack output, bundles and lock source fields.
Git object-link materialization across hosts exceeds simple local package replay.
Traps registry-only proxy exact pins installing idempotently and frozen replay; needs proxy, git shim and cache clean.
Traps slashed MCP server removal deleting short-name user entries (#3493); needs custom MCP names across five targets.
Claude plugin MCP lifecycle uses a non-Copilot target and plugin package shape.
Claude plugin MCP shapes and file-content assertions exceed supported row scope.
Traps targeted install reconciling a dropped transitive dependency; needs claude target, user scope and lock resolved_by fields.
Symlinked lockfile refusal is an explicitly excluded symlink edge case.
Marketplace producer-consumer, pack, and git-ref behavior exceed row vocabulary.
Traps licence files carried, locked, audited and removed with subdirectory packages (#3556); needs LICENSE bytes, carried_licenses lock fields, git subdirectories.
Traps cold update moving/dropping/adding transitives and plugin restamp; needs git tags, clones, cache corruption, baseline binary.
Org-wide lifecycle-script policy is outside the replay world's policy model.
Traps semver ranges selecting pre-release tags in outdated/update (#3601); needs git tags, semver ranges and resolved_ref lock values.
Traps audit replaying an apm.yml plus plugin.json source as a legacy plugin (#3604); custom package shape and lock package_type block a row.
Traps view -g --file reporting user-scope provenance read-only with unicode HOME; needs user scope and unicode paths.
Receipt-less update behavior asserts local receipt ownership and fresh-clone recovery.
Traps auto-bootstrapped apm.yml author handling under org policy and init metadata (#3630, #2231); needs init, pack, policy and manifest fields.
Policy chains and native MCP config byte comparisons exceed replay rows.
SSH transport and cache behavior are excluded source semantics.
Traps mixed-case parent identity in transitive lock edges; needs case-variant git remotes, deps tree/why and lock field values.
Frozen deployed-hash verification includes scope and content-integrity edge cases.
Compile preservation is explicitly outside supported replay commands.
Edited managed files and user-owned skill contents trigger refusal paths not represented in rows.
Traps install/audit disagreeing on denied transitives and cached policy (#3658, #3659); needs org policy server and policy cache expiry.
Traps selected-profile uninstall touching another runtime default root; needs user scope and Claude/Hermes profiles.
Retention of undeclared frozen packages tests a distinct lock and ownership rule.
Traps cleanup deleting user files claimed by unhashed lock rows on fresh clones (#3663); needs a forged lockfile and git clone.
Traps MCP servers left in configs after their opt-in runtime directory is pruned (#3664); needs claude/opencode MCP and user servers.
Traps retiring a deleted hook file's merged settings.json events while keeping user hooks; needs claude target and settings bytes.
Traps audit flagging contained-link instructions from local packages as orphaned (#3667); requires OS symlinks, so not a row.
Traps prune/install dropping a still-transitive dependency after its direct line is removed (#3668); needs hand-edited apm.yml, prune and lock depth fields.
Traps update re-pinning children and dev reachability surviving uninstall; needs branch-tracking git refs and is_dev lock fields.
Traps pack/marketplace producer bugs: phantom --allow-head, missing tags, hook scripts, dropped symlinks (#3670); pack and marketplace block a row.
The deps-list to uninstall-key interface is a distinct command contract.
Traps same-name user MCP connections reported as already configured on JSON adapters (#3681); needs MCP config bytes, registry and many targets.
Traps audit reporting skipped user same-name files as managed edits (#3682); needs user collision files, case-only paths and JSON drift kinds.
Traps audit root discovery and missing-manifest exit behavior beyond replay-row assertions.
YAML scalar quoting and lockfile field representation are excluded.
Traps duplicate dependencies/devDependencies moves and uninstall of every spelling; needs install --dev, is_dev lock fields, git pins.
Traps same owner/repo from two hosts or ports colliding in apm_modules (#3696, #3927); needs multiple git hosts and aliases.
Nested declaration refusal is a manifest validation contract.
Traps bundle hooks parking behind executables gate then registering like source; needs pack bundles, claude target, user scope.
Tests local deployment receipt contents, which replay rows cannot assert.
Traps compile-only bundle staging becoming deployment claims and Markdown agents in Codex TOML (#3705, #3706, #3718); needs pack, compile, other targets.
Traps approve granting the original identity instead of the replace: source (#3710); needs replace rules, forks, claude hooks and grant keys.
Traps audit failing config-consistency on deliberately parked MCP servers (#3720, #3925); needs claude MCP, omission evidence and transitive trust.
Traps org mcp.transport.allow judging effective transport before writes; needs policy cache and local MCP registry.
Traps audit/uninstall ignoring the recorded legacy skill layout and moved COPILOT_HOME (#3773, #3745); needs legacy flag and user scope.
Traps audit demanding apm_modules after service-only update -g; needs user scope and released-version lockfiles.
Traps apm init re-init mapping singular target: to targets:; init is outside replay vocabulary.
Traps YAML anchors in apm.yml being accepted or partially applied (#3858, #3871); needs malformed manifests and many reader commands.
Traps root .mcp.json heal from retired vscode/github files and vscode alias (#3866, #3868); needs MCP JSON bytes, legacy locks and many targets.
User-manifest target bootstrap and write refusal exceed project replay rows.
Traps root replace: source selection, fork slots, cache invalidation and failure rollback; needs replacement lock fields, git forks, symlinks.
Traps a failed multi-package install leaving untracked deployed files (#3874); needs git refs, an invalid package and claude target.
IDE target refusal is a distinct command and diagnostic contract.
Traps machine-local state overriding the lock: stale apm_modules, ref bumps, plugin-root paths (#3884, #3883, #3825); needs git, clones, MCP/LSP.
External APM_HOME and global audit exercise user scope.
Traps intentional MCP omission persisting while real drift still fails audit; needs mcp_omissions lock fields and global scope.
Marketplace lock replay and ref-pinning behavior are explicitly excluded.
Catalog origin evidence and Git marketplace provenance exceed local-path replay sources.
Marketplace dependency-confusion refusal and enterprise Git sources are excluded.
Executable gate semantics and hook retirement are beyond the replay world's supported deny model.
Executable gate, organization policy, and frozen behavior exceed simple package approval rows.
Traps uninstall of object-form marketplace declaration offline; marketplace is outside replay vocabulary.
Local bundle packaging and authored MCP config assertions exceed row vocabulary.
Traps approved local-bundle MCP servers surviving revoke, deny or repack (#3956); needs packed bundles, claude MCP and lock provenance.
Traps wrong remediation after deny (#3957): frozen message and layered approve; needs claude MCP, user store and multi-layer denies.
Traps rebound marketplace alias failing closed on install and outdated; needs marketplace catalogs and global scope.
Marketplace object-form dry-run is outside the supported replay commands.
Traps plugin-only pack printing target deprecation exactly once; pack is outside replay vocabulary.
Pack output and MCP ownership are outside supported replay commands.
Dry-run preview and retired target healing are outside the row command vocabulary.
Traps policy refusals and approve usage errors landing on stderr; needs blocking org policy and stream split.
Traps non-default-host require entries failing both presence checks (#3993); needs org policy file, git host rewrites and audit JSON details.
Cold restore and edited deployment failure checks include byte-specific transactional assertions.
User-scope local-bundle lock rows are excluded from project-only replay.
Tests shared orphan-removal ownership across unsupported preview/prune command paths.
Traps trust/integrity consistency across bundle, uninstall, update and unpack; needs org policy, bundles, unpack, user scope.
Traps required-package identity under replace: (req-rpl-002); needs org policy over HTTPS proxy, fork hosts and audit check details.
Removed init flags are outside the replay command vocabulary.
